list.description: Lists information about the supported locations for this service. name.description: Output only. The name of the CNAME record for the domain, equals to `dns_resource_record.name` in the corresponding `DnsAuthorization`.

resolvedData.description: Output only. The resolved CNAME chain. Empty list if the CNAME record for `CNAME.name` is not found. Otherwise the first item is the value of the CNAME record for `CNAME.name`. If the CNAME chain is longer, the second item is the value of the CNAME record for the first item, and so on.
